title: <name> and the Case of the Vanishing Cookies

pages.text: It was a sunny afternoon, and <name> had just helped bake a batch of chocolate-chip cookies with his mom. He set them on the kitchen counter to cool… and when he turned around for a glass of milk, they were gone!

“Who took them?” <name> wondered, scratching his head.

He spotted tiny crumbs on the floor leading toward the living room. He whispered to his little sister, “Come on, let’s follow the trail!” They tiptoed after the crumbs, careful not to wake the nap-time cat.

A few cookie wrappers fluttered near the sofa. Suddenly, a mischievous puppy dashed past, carrying a cookie in its mouth! <name> and his sister giggled as they tiptoed and crawled behind the puppy, who seemed to think this was a fun game of chase.

The crumbs led them past the dining table, around the bookshelf, and finally to a funny, unexpected hiding spot — the puppy had pushed a chair and curled up inside, surrounded by the cookies like a fluffy treasure guard!
<name> laughed, scooping up the remaining cookies and giving the puppy a gentle pat. “So that’s where you were hiding them!” he said. His sister helped him arrange the cookies back on the counter.

<name> realized that observing small clues, working together, and thinking cleverly could solve even the silliest mysteries. And sometimes, the solution is funny, playful, and full of laughter — just like a puppy guarding a mountain of cookies.

That day, <name> enjoyed the cookies with extra giggles, knowing that teamwork and curiosity turn even tiny problems into memorable adventures.
